info.title: Troya Gate
info.description: A fresh, signed pre-trade safety check for any token on Robinhood Chain (chain 4663), run at your trade size: can it be bought and sold, the real taxes, price impact, honeypot and liquidity tests, plus dev and holder flags. Every result is signed by the Troya attestor so any agent can verify it. Pay per call over x402: $0.05 in USDC on Base, Arbitrum or Polygon, or USDG on Robinhood Chain. No account, no API key. Charged only after the check runs.

get.summary: Signed pre-trade safety check for a Robinhood Chain token
get.description: Answers 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402 v2). Send the signed payment as PAYMENT-SIGNATURE and receive the signed result. The payment settles only after the check ran.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Token contract address on Robinhood Chain (0x + 40 hex)

parameters.name: amountEth
parameters.description: Trade size in ETH to test at, 0.0001 to 5 (default 0.01)

parameters.name: assay
parameters.description: 1 adds dev, holder and bundle flags (default 1)

attested.description: The attested result: token, symbol, amountEth, verdict (passed, caution, failed, untested), reason, checks[], quote, assay, checkedAt

signature.description: EIP-191 signature of "Troya Gate result\n<hash>" by the attestor

402.description: Payment required. The PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64 JSON, x402 v2) lists the accepted networks, assets, amount and payTo, plus the Bazaar extension.
